title: Job Search Method
intro: The Cible Retour à l'Emploi team offers you accelerated support over 6 meetings. Together, we will approach your return to work in the most efficient way possible.
serviceItems: Assessment of your professional needs, preferences, and aspirations
Interview preparation based on your needs
eligibility: For people aged 16 and over, with at least a Secondary 3 education.
frequency: Meetings take place once a week until a job is obtained, up to a maximum of 6 meetings.
